campaign: world-engine production-L1 port (full-A render port, increment 1 of 2)

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A coarse, sphere-native relief HEIGHT field is generated as DATA once per body and baked into a sampleable carrier (cube), deterministically — same drivers+seed => byte-identical baked field; values finite and bounded. This is the structure-as-data the renderer will read (no in-shader height synthesis for the low-frequency body).

verifyVia.input: Run the bake for a given driver bundle + seed twice (headless / Node + vitest).
verifyVia.observable: The two baked height fields are byte-identical; all values finite within the documented relief range; the field is materialized as data (a typed array / baked cube), not a shader expression.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The lab renderer DISPLACES the surface from the baked height field (the relief body IS the sampled field, not noised()); a strength uniform gates it, and at strength 0 the planet is byte-identical to today (safe fallback, WS4 pattern).

verifyVia.input: On :9223, enable baked-relief at strength 1, then dial to 0; observe the lab planet (window._lab).
verifyVia.observable: At strength 1 the surface visibly deforms to match the baked field (displacement tracks the sampled height, verifiable via a uniform/field probe); at strength 0 the render is byte-identical to the pre-increment baseline.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The existing sphere-native river router routes on the SAME baked height field the surface is displaced from (re-pointed from the in-shader readback) — a single height source, no surface-vs-rivers data/noise split. Drainage follows the baked relief.

verifyVia.input: On :9223, route rivers over a built body with baked-relief on; compare the router's height source to the displaced surface field.
verifyVia.observable: Router height source == the baked field (not the legacy in-shader readback); drainage descends the baked relief (0 uphill/orphan edges; trunks reach the sea); router-lab regression stats hold (ocean ~35%, maxStrahler in band).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The baked relief and the drainage are continuous across cube seams and at the poles — no seam ridge, no pole pinch/artifact. (The critics' FIRST acceptance gate: longitudinally-varying baked height on a sphere has never been exercised in this codebase.)

verifyVia.input: Headless: sample the baked cube across all seam boundaries + poles. Live (:9223): orbit the body across each seam and both poles.
verifyVia.observable: Headless seam-sample delta below threshold across every seam/pole (continuous field); live view shows no seam line, no ridge at cube edges, no pole pinch; drainage crosses seams without breaking.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Looking at the lab planet as a whole, the low-frequency relief reads as the result of generated structure (data) — a coherent system, not random scatter — with drainage cut into that same relief. Judged against the WS4-SCOPED bar (coherent tectonic system + drainage), NOT 'where are Earth's continents' (deferred to Option C).

verifyVia.input: Max walks the lab on :9223: build a body, toggle baked-relief off->on and strength, orbit it.
verifyVia.observable: Max's holistic judgment: the relief reads as coming from generated structure (not an orientation overlay on noise), drainage runs down that relief, and it coheres across the sphere.
